transforms.name: no-usage
transforms.effect: The pipeline never emits usage:tokens-used. Session JSONL usage stays excluded.

transforms.name: translateAgentEventEnvelope
transforms.effect: Maps the AgentEvent into monitor family updates. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: acceptAgentEvent
transforms.effect: Admits the runtime-plane input. session:exited and process:exited do not clear liveness without host process evidence. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: price-before-reduce
transforms.effect: accept() runs priceUsageUpdates on runtime and semantic updates before reduceMonitorAccumulator. Reported nonnegative costUsd, including zero, wins. Otherwise pricing needs this upsert's own pricing metadata. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: priceUsageUpdates
transforms.effect: The selector prices a usage upsert only when canonical, pricing, or costUsd is set. None of these adapters set pricing or costUsd. pi reaches neither arm. pipeline.ts does not emit usage:tokens-used, and monitor.ts publishes an empty update list. buildUsageCostLedger's loop does not run, so neither the guarded increment nor the skip branch is taken. priced and unpriced stay 0.

transforms.name: priceUsage
transforms.effect: With no reported costUsd and no pricing metadata, priceUsage returns cost source unavailable and leaves costUsd unset. It does not read the row model, and the catalog is not consulted.

transforms.name: reduce-after-price
transforms.effect: reduceMonitorAccumulator stores the updates priceUsageUpdates already rewrote. These adapters do not pass through translateAgentEventEnvelope's usage:tokens-used case, which copies an event's own costUsd before pricing. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: usage-index-stream
transforms.effect: usageIndexOf builds the index before any cost projection. buildUsageIndex folds selected usage into the run stream, and stream calls buildUsageCostLedger there. This ledger is clock-free and runs before project.ts copies a usage result. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: buildUsageIndex
transforms.effect: The run stream at usage-index.ts:427 passes every selected usage entry into that ledger. queryUsageIndex has not run yet. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: ledger-counts
transforms.effect: A finite nonnegative costUsd, including 0, increments priced and adds to the total. A missing, invalid, or negative costUsd increments unpriced only when canonical, pricing, or cost is truthy. A sample with none of those is skipped and does not increment unpriced. pi reaches neither arm. pipeline.ts does not emit usage:tokens-used, and monitor.ts publishes an empty update list. buildUsageCostLedger's loop does not run, so neither the guarded increment nor the skip branch is taken. priced and unpriced stay 0. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: coverage-decision
transforms.effect: queryUsageIndex calls projectUsageCost only after the ledger exists. priced greater than 0 and unpriced 0 is complete, and the USD total may be 0. priced greater than 0 and unpriced greater than 0 is partial. priced 0 omits this run's costUsd and costRatePerMin and sets coverage unavailable. These adapters stay on priced 0. An unpriced increment does not by itself make coverage partial. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: projectUsageCost
transforms.effect: projectUsageCost reads the ledger counts. It does not rebuild them, and it does not turn priced 0 into a USD total. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: project-copy
transforms.effect: project.ts:346-351 runs usageIndexOf and queryUsageIndex. Line 417 then copies that usage result onto AgentMonitorState. The copy does not build the cost ledger. [post-0.3.3]

transforms.name: epoch-observe
transforms.effect: The backend observes the projected usage before costOf. The backend default at backend.ts:132 is accumulate when a host omits the option. Godview sets accumulate and keeps a prior epoch's costUsd when the current run has priced 0. VibeField sets current and replaces that one run. burnPerHour is the current costRatePerMin times 60, not the retained sum, and that rate is omitted when priced is 0.

transforms.name: godview-accumulate
transforms.effect: The Puppeteer Godview host sets acrossEpochs accumulate. That can retain an earlier epoch's costUsd. These adapters never write costUsd on any epoch, so there is no retained total to keep.

transforms.name: vibefield-current-epoch
transforms.effect: VibeField createMonitorBackend sets acrossEpochs current. A new epoch replaces the run instead of adding its costUsd to earlier epochs.

transforms.name: history-aggregate
transforms.effect: historyOf sums costUsd across the runs observe retained. history.total is absent only when no retained run has costUsd. That is this path: current mode replaces the run, and the run's priced count is 0.

transforms.name: row-cost
transforms.effect: costOf returns undefined when history.total is undefined, and the row omits field.cost. That is state.cost_missing. A present field.cost with coverage unavailable, state.cost_unavailable, is not emitted. When a retained total exists, usd is that sum and burnPerHour is the current rate times 60.

transforms.name: derive-cost
transforms.effect: deriveAgentRow copies input.cost when costOf returned an object, including a USD total of 0. Here costOf returned undefined, so cost is omitted.

transforms.name: createMonitorBackend
transforms.effect: fieldd hosts the monitor backend on the runtime source and passes the current-epoch cost reading.

transforms.name: wireMonitorRow
transforms.effect: The model wire drops device.self. This desktop's window otherwise reads the row whole.

transforms.name: peerMonitorRow
transforms.effect: A peer loses project.seq and has detail, activity line, wait text, and reply text bounded.

transforms.name: modelRowFrom
transforms.effect: The reader restores device.self and fills a missing writable from attachable.

transforms.name: replica.join
transforms.effect: The replica join spreads the agent row. It does not recompute cost.

transforms.name: window-rows
transforms.effect: window-rows rewrites peer stale and drops peer profileSet. It spreads the rest of the row and does not recompute cost.

transforms.name: spend-reader
transforms.effect: spendOf returns nothing when cost is missing or coverage is unavailable. A missing cost is not drawn as zero.

defaults.when: this adapter's traced producers do not supply the row field

applicability.notes: Views listed are confirmed readers in the five shipping monitor views.

verification.notes: Declared usage=unsupported. Session JSONL usage is excluded. No independent live usage rail is integrated. Corrected cost chain from puppeteer 68dde825266e63ba63a1b07f7fcfd1e85f868b1f, checked at pins vibefield 433505fd and puppeteer 748d015. Order: priceUsageUpdates before reduce; buildUsageCostLedger inside buildUsageIndex before queryUsageIndex; project.ts copies the usage result only after that projection; observe then splits acrossEpochs accumulate from current; historyOf; costOf; derive. pi reaches neither arm. pipeline.ts does not emit usage:tokens-used, and monitor.ts publishes an empty update list. buildUsageCostLedger's loop does not run, so neither the guarded increment nor the skip branch is taken. priced and unpriced stay 0. VibeField uses acrossEpochs current (agent-monitor.ts:480), so a new epoch replaces the run. Godview uses accumulate (main.ts:744), which could keep an earlier epoch's costUsd, but no epoch of these adapters has one. priced 0 omits costUsd, so history.total stays absent and costOf omits field.cost. That is state.cost_missing. state.cost_unavailable is not emitted. A working observed swarm body with no complete or partial cost is state.burn_unpriced. state.cost_complete, state.cost_partial, and state.burn_flames_0 through state.burn_flames_4 cannot occur. Disagree with the Claude graph's reduce.ts:1049-1073 step: that case copies the event's costUsd inside acceptAgentEvent before accept() prices updates, and these adapters do not go through it. Audit pin is puppeteer 748d015, newer than the 0.3.3 package vibefield ships (tag v0.3.3, commit 52d09c8e). This record does not compare 0.3.3 behavior. A transform effect ending in [post-0.3.3] cites a puppeteer file whose text differs from 52d09c8e.
